name: Civora
tagline: The operating system for the governed community.
positioning: Civora unifies board governance, reserves, and resident operations into one intelligent platform built for portfolios of a thousand communities.

hero.sub: Civora replaces the patchwork of spreadsheets, email chains, and legacy portals with a single command center for the largest HOA and community-association portfolios on earth.

features.title: Board Chambers
features.description: Run motions, quorums, and minutes from one room. Agendas, votes, and signed resolutions become an auditable record your counsel can trust.

features.title: Reserve Intelligence
features.description: Model 30-year reserve studies across thousands of associations and see funding gaps before they become special assessments.

features.title: Resident Fabric
features.description: Every violation notice, ARC request, and dues ledger for every homeowner, unified into a profile your managers can act on instantly.

features.title: Compliance Grid
features.description: Track state statutes, CC&R deadlines, and audit windows across jurisdictions with alerts that reach the right board seat.

features.title: Dues Rails
features.description: Automated assessments, delinquency workflows, and lien pipelines that move money and paperwork without a single manual reminder.

features.title: Portfolio Horizon
features.description: One dashboard spanning every community you manage, surfacing risk, cash position, and open work across the entire portfolio.

testimonials.quote: We manage 640 associations across four states. Before Civora, our reserve studies lived in eleven different systems. Now every board sees the same numbers, and our special-assessment surprises dropped to near zero.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ferraro

testimonials.quote: The Board Chambers module turned our two-week minutes backlog into a same-night signed record. Our general counsel actually asked how we did it.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

testimonials.quote: Civora is the first platform that treats a 12,000-door portfolio like one organism instead of 300 separate fires. Our managers finally have time to manage.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan

pricing.blurb: For regional managers consolidating their first portfolios onto one system.
For established firms running multi-state operations at scale.
For the largest managers governing hundreds of thousands of doors.

homepage.footerBlurb: Civora is the operating system for the governed community — unifying boards, reserves, and residents across the world's largest association portfolios.
